threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's just a funky café with a name like 'The Grind' instead of a full-on coffee cult. Welcome to your caffeine initiation.
Caught the N137 last night; two guys debating if they could outrun a fox. Must've been at least ten minutes of serious strategy talk.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Sitting in Körnerpark, I watched a group of kids play soccer while an old man painted the roses. That mix of energy and tranquility? That’s Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain do you find a club where the sound system is designed by an acoustics nerd who used to work in a car factory.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their reaction to the Civic Center Muni delays—rolling their eyes but still clutching a half-eaten burrito, like it’s just another Tuesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 Fulton this morning—saw a guy using a skateboard to carry his groceries. Only in San Francisco do you get culinary creativity on wheels.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always ask for 'the best tapas,' but the hidden spots in local corners serve better dishes than the trendy bars.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always ask for directions to Park Güell like it's a local secret, but we all know it's just a tourist trap.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still use your phone to check bus times instead of just looking at the stop. Real locals know the buses run on vibes.
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Clapham and a guy in a parrot costume just sat down, chatting with a sleeping stranger. Only in London.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh döner mingling with diesel fumes from the bus in Hermannplatz on a Friday evening. That's when it hit me—this is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a random art installation made out of old bikes in the park, accompanied by spontaneous dance-offs every weekend.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Locals know to avoid Civic Center when smoke alarms go off; tourists think it’s just part of the experience. No one’s rushing to the station.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a couple share a bottle of wine while waiting for the 21 to show. No one batted an eye, just another day in the 'Loin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists keep asking for 'authentic' tapas but miss that the real vibe is in the late-night pinchos at locals’ bars, not the menus.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by how they gawk at the metro map, struggling with the different lines like it’s a treasure map, while locals zip by without a second glance.
